change.source: finding 1 (an agent whose delegation lapsed still closes, without the header, the inbox it opened for the person): round 1b (ea37f40) adds a rule of the service: close-inbox for an inbox that exists and is not the caller's inbox is answered not-owner, byte for byte the model's own not-owner, and an address no inbox has is still unknown-inbox; the reviewer's case security_delegation::a_lapsed_delegation_leaves_its_agent_no_close_of_the_persons_inbox was red (left closed, right not-owner) and is green; delegation::after_the_lapse_the_persons_inbox_stays_open_and_nobody_closes_it holds the state after the lapse; 3 mutants of the rule are each red in a named case
